description: Check a captured request's webhook signature: Standard Webhooks, Stripe or an HMAC header.

body.description: The request's raw body, exactly as sent, when no `request_id` is given.

encoding.description: For `hmac`: how the digest is written, as hex digits or in Base 64 [default: hex].

header.description: For `hmac`: the header holding the digest [default: X-Signature].

headers.description: The request's headers, when no `request_id` is given.

prefix.description: For `hmac`: text before the digest, such as `sha256=` [default: none].

request_id.description: A captured request's ID, from an HTTP Catcher bin; or give `headers` and `body`.

secret.description: The signing secret the app checks with; never logged.

tolerance_seconds.description: How far a signed timestamp may be from now, in seconds [default: 300].

name: sendmock_webhook_signature_verify
